item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 11/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will continue to affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. It will be fine and dry over the region. It will be cold in the morning, very cold over inland areas, where the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream early next week, it will be cloudier and temperatures will rise slightly over the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of another surge of the monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will fall again and it will be rather cool in the morning.
